detail.longDescription:
Learn to code with AI in just 5 minutes a day. CodingX turns programming into short, fun lessons, then rewards you for showing up every day.

Start with AI-Powered Python or Generative AI, then explore Java, C++, web development, ethical hacking and more. No experience needed: every course starts from the basics and builds up to real projects.

LEARN WITH AI
• AI Playground: write a prompt, get real code and run it
• Build with AI: make games, websites and small apps, then play and share them
• Prompt Library: ready-to-use prompts for writing, study, images and code

10 COURSES IN ONE APP
• AI-Powered Python
• Generative AI & AI Tools
• Java
• C and C++
• Web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• Ethical Hacking
• Blockchain
• Game Development
• Digital Marketing

PRACTICE REAL CODE
• Built-in compiler: write and run code right on your phone
• Python programs and coding challenges with instant feedback
• Quizzes after every topic and a final test for each course
• Earn badges and course certificates as you finish

STAY MOTIVATED EVERY DAY
• Daily streaks: learn every day, protect your streak with streak freezes and celebrate milestones
• XP and Bytes: earn rewards for every lesson, quiz and challenge
• Daily tasks: three new goals every day with bonus Bytes
• Weekly leagues: compete with other learners, climb ten leagues and win prizes
• Streak widgets: keep your streak on your home screen with 12 designs
• Daily reminders at the time you choose, or add lessons to your calendar

LEARN WITH FRIENDS
• Forum: share your achievements, react to other learners' milestones and follow people
• Friends: add friends, compare weekly XP and see each other's progress
• Profiles: pick an avatar and your own learner ID
• Invite & Earn: invite friends and get ad-free time when they start learning

MADE FOR YOU
• Personal learning plan based on your goals
• Bite-sized lessons with code examples, illustrations and interactive questions
• Track your progress for every course in one place
• Works on phones and tablets
• Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian and Arabic

Whether you're preparing for a developer job, studying for exams or just curious about AI and coding, CodingX helps you learn a little every day and keep going.

Questions or ideas? Email us at hello@codingx.app. We read every message.
Website: www.codingx.app
